decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the available products based on my need for a versatile backpack. The search results included many irrelevant items (towels, chairs, stoves), so I filtered for actual backpacks. Among the consideration set, the HIKPRO 20L (prod_backpacks_006) stood out for its exceptional 4.7 rating and high durability/packability at a very competitive price point. While the ZOMAKE (prod_backpacks_173) was cheaper, the HIKPRO had slightly better customer feedback. The High Sierra (prod_backpacks_068) was a strong contender for heavy-duty hiking but represented a much larger investment and had some mixed reviews regarding hip comfort.
